pages.text: Use an Item Trash Can to destroy unwanted items. Open its inventory and deposit stacks, or insert with a hopper or item pipe. The contents are deleted on the next server tick.

pages.title: Fluid and Energy
pages.text: A Fluid Trash Can deletes fluid accepted from pipes. Right-click it with a filled bucket to discard the contents and keep the empty bucket.$(br2)The Energy Trash Can consumes incoming Forge Energy. It is useful as a sink when testing a generator.
